data.name: Aaron
data.gender_notes: Aaron is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aaron comes from the Hebrew word אַרְוֹן (arōn), which means mountain or height. In Islamic tradition, this name is believed to symbolize strength, power, and resilience. The name Aaron carries the meaning “Mountain of strength” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaron usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aaron belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaron total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Aaron
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aaron originates from the Arabic root 'H-R-W-N', which means 'exalted', 'strong', or 'helper'. In Islamic tradition, Aaron (Harun in Arabic) is known as the brother of Prophet Moses (Musa) and is mentioned in the Quran as a prophet endowed with spiritual guidance and support from the Holy Spirit (Ruhu'l-Kudüs). The name symbolizes leadership, prophetic guidance, and divine support.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, Aaron (Harun in Arabic) is recognized as a pious and honorable prophet who contributed to the spiritual development of the early Israelites. His legacy extends to more broad universal significance that resonates with Muslim communities. As Christians and Jews continue to practice their religions and maintain their distinct cultural identities, the lessons learned from Aaron's leadership and perseverance remain relevant.
data.spiritual_significance: Aaron is a reminder of the power and importance of faith and leadership in times of trials and challenges. Through his unwavering commitment to God and his role as a leader, Aaron demonstrates the ability for individuals to remain good and righteous even in the face of adversity. Muslims may draw inspiration from Aaron's story to trust in the divine plan and seek guidance during times of difficulty. Aaron's commitment to his community and faith serves as an excellent model for emulating in everyday life.
